findings.title: Corrected module promises acceptanceProvenance on a 503 response that omits it
findings.rationale: The corrected ST-CON-05 dispatch prose explicitly specifies acceptanceProvenance=ACKNOWLEDGED in the post-ACK TEMPLATE_SUBMISSION_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE response. In the embedded TemplateSubmissionService.submitDraft, the catch around recordAcknowledgedOutcome constructs a new exception containing outcome/phase ACCEPTED, providerAcceptance CONFIRMED and receiptPersistence UNCONFIRMED, but no acceptanceProvenance. It therefore also discards that field when an inner exception supplies it. The subsequent projection-failure response omits it too. Persisted operation and receipt projections do expose provenance separately. The original outbound-message contamination is corrected, but this newly edited canonical response description still differs from the actual source. This is a narrow correction-locus discrepancy, not a reopening of accepted product debt.
findings.suggested_action: Adjust only the module prose to match the actual 503 response fields. Describe acknowledged external acceptance through providerAcceptance=CONFIRMED, and distinguish that knowledge from provenance returned by persisted operation/receipt projections. Refresh the module-consistency disposition while retaining prior receipts unchanged. Preserve product behavior, ST-CON-06 documentation and existing assurance; no broad test rerun or renewed product approval is needed.
